scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/auth -w packages/database -w packages/functions -w packages/realtime -w packages/sdk-js -w packages/storage
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w apps/server
scripts.dev:all: npm run build:packages && concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/server -w apps/dashboard -w examples/pos-kiosk
